full_judgment: 2. The petitioners as Pre-remptors filed Miscellaneous Case No.85 of 1997 before the learned Assistant Judge, Rajbari for pre-emption of the case land under Section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950, on contending inter alia that they are co-sharers by purchase and contiguous land holders and the opposite parties transferred the case land beyond the knowledge of the pre-emptors, by registered kabala dated 29.05.1997, and the same was registered under section 60 of the Registration Act on 17.07.1997.
